firstPlayerRule: The youngest player takes the First player token and starts.
houseFallback: If this criterion does not suit your group, agree to choose randomly. This is a house rule.
clarifications: Figure placement, and then taking actions, both start with the first player and go clockwise.
At the end of each round, the First player token passes to the next player clockwise.

internalEvidence: Downloaded https://cdn.svc.asmodee.net/production-zman/uploads/2024/10/zm7260_stone_age_rules.pdf, the English rulebook linked from the publisher page https://www.zmangames.com/game/stone-age/. SHA-256: 52b745af7e502b5d9d99b34a4b0472669790d4a62312db9fcc8cdbd8802c7ca8. Read the extracted text of PDF pages 2, 4, 5, 7 and 8. Page 2, setup step 13: ‘The youngest player takes the First player token’. Pages 4–5: the first player places first, then clockwise; actions also start with the first player. Page 7: the First player token passes clockwise at the end of the round. Page 8 shows © 2008–2014 Hans im Glück and © 2013 F2Z Entertainment, identifying the Stone Age base game (BGG 34635).
